info.title: Web Fetcher
info.description: Fetches urls and circumvents anti-bot detection: Impit first, Camoufox as fallback.

get.summary: Fetch an url, returns the plain content (GET)
get.description:
Fetches the url, first with Impit (browser TLS fingerprint, no JavaScript) and escalates to Camoufox
(anti-detect Firefox) on failures, status codes > 299 or if the page requires JavaScript.

Returns the plain response content with the content type of the fetched response: text is always UTF-8, binary
content (images, PDFs, ...) is returned as is. Details about the fetched response are in the `X-Fetch-*` headers:
* `X-Fetch-Engine`, `X-Fetch-Status`, `X-Fetch-Final-Url`
* `X-Fetch-Header-<name>`: every header of the fetched response (the total size of response headers is limited
  by many clients / proxies, e.g. to 16 KB)
* `X-Fetch-Cookie`: every raw `Set-Cookie` value of the fetched response

Use `/fetch/details` to get everything in a JSON body.

400.description: Invalid parameters or no applicable engine.

403.description: The url points to a local or private address, which is not allowed.

502.description: No engine delivered a usable response.

504.description: All engines ran into the timeout.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The url to fetch (http or https).

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds. Unset or < 1 = no timeout.

parameters.name: fingerprint
parameters.description: Browser fingerprint like `firefox`, `chrome`, `firefox144` or `chrome131`. Defaults to `chrome`. Camoufox always uses Firefox.

parameters.name: followRedirects
parameters.description: Follow redirects. Defaults to true. Ignored by Camoufox (a browser always follows redirects).

parameters.name: engines
parameters.description: Engines to try, in this order. Unset = default order (Impit, then Camoufox). Escalates to the next engine on failures, status > 299 or a detected JavaScript wall.

parameters.name: executeJavaScript
parameters.description: Unset: default behaviour. true: skips Impit. false: disables JavaScript in Camoufox (and no escalation because of a JavaScript wall).

parameters.name: loadLazyContent
parameters.description: If true, Camoufox scrolls to the end of the page to load lazy loading content. Skips Impit.

post.summary: Fetch an url, returns the plain content (POST)
post.description:

get.summary: Fetch an url, returns the details as JSON (GET)
get.description:
Fetches the url, first with Impit (browser TLS fingerprint, no JavaScript) and escalates to Camoufox
(anti-detect Firefox) on failures, status codes > 299 or if the page requires JavaScript.

Returns a JSON wrapper with the content, status code, headers, cookies, elapsed time, final url and the engine that
fetched the response. Binary content is base64 encoded (see `contentEncoding`).

content.description: The decoded text (HTML gets a <base href> if there was none) or, for binary content, base64.

contentEncoding.description: `Text` or `Base64` (binary responses like images or PDFs).

headers.description: Lower-case header names, without set-cookie (see cookies).

elapsedMs.description: Total elapsed time, including failed attempts of previous engines.

engine.description: The engine that fetched this response.

400.description: Invalid parameters or no applicable engine.

403.description: The url points to a local or private address, which is not allowed.

502.description: No engine delivered a usable response.

504.description: All engines ran into the timeout.
